description: A Flask-based REST API implementation for managing authors and quotes, including database models, schemas, and route handlers.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Declarative base class for SQLAlchemy models.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Model representing an author with id, first name, and last name.

classes.name: Quote
classes.description: Model representing a quote with content, author, and posted date.

classes.name: AuthorSchema
classes.description: Marshmallow schema for serializing and deserializing Author objects, including formatted name method.

classes.name: QuoteSchema
classes.description: Marshmallow schema for serializing and deserializing Quote objects, with custom pre_load processing for author data.

methods.name: must_not_be_blank
methods.description: Validator to ensure data is not blank.

methods.name: process_author
methods.description: Pre-load hook to parse author's full name into first and last.

methods.name: get_authors
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve all authors.

methods.name: get_author
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a specific author and their quotes by ID.

methods.name: get_quotes
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve all quotes.

methods.name: get_quote
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a specific quote by ID.

methods.name: new_quote
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new quote, creating author if necessary.
